reviews.title: AI Calorie estimates are useless.
reviews.text:
I have two major problems with this app aside from the egregious cost… 

The AI Calorie estimates through pictures are basically useless. So I stopped submitting my meals as it was simply a waste of time. I am doing primarily OMAD, and trust me when I say, I eat a very large portion during my OMAD. For whatever reason, the AI gets it wrong every time. Even if I try to be specific with weight and descriptions. 

Second problem, I do OMAD M-F and 16-8 or 18-6 on the weekends. The app has no ability to set a schedule for different types of fasting for different days, and for the price, I’m really disappointed. This would be an easy feature to add and I’m surprised that they haven’t thought of it yet. 

I’m glad I gave it a try, but the free trial wasn’t nearly long enough to get a real sense of the functionality, so I idiotically signed up for the year subscription. It’s nice that it gives me reminders and whatnot, but the tips were only mildly accurate and less than insightful. I’ll be canceling my subscription indefinitely and immediately. 

Hope this helps someone thinking about wasting the money. But fasting absolutely works and I highly recommend it to almost anyone.

reviews.title: Extremely concerning account and data deletion experience
reviews.text:
The whole experience feels more like personal-data mining than a trustworthy health app. 

Installed the app and Zero immediately collected a lot of personal and health data. It then pushed a subscription popup covering the entire screen, with no close button, leaving me unable to access my account or profile data, unless I subscribe. Eventually I accepted the free weekly trial just to access my profile on the app. 

I then tries to delete my account and data from inside the app, which repeatedly and consistently results in a system error. 

I sent them a request to delete the account and data - customer service advised me to delete it from the app, exactly what doesn’t work. 

The app and service seem to be designed to make it hard to remove your personal data. The app also doesn’t have any really useful free features. 

Extremely concerning, especially as a EU user.

reviews.title: From Perfect to Pathetic
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app for YEARS. Since around 2019. And let me tell you— it’s a shell of what it once was. It started as an app with all the functionality I needed: it allowed me to track my fasts, view my past fasts, and track my weight in a weekly, monthly, and yearly view for FREE. Then all these new features began to be added. Log your meals and you mood when your finish your fast and log your sleep, for free, and you could see the different stages of your fasts and get additional insight and fasting advice, for a subscription. Since then they’ve added log your water intake. Log your calories and your protein intake. Log your glucose, your ketone levels, your activity, and your heart rate. But you can only actually view any of your OWN data from the current week. You used to be able to see your fasts in a calendar view that told you your total fasting hours for the month and an overview of how many times you met your goals that month, plus your total fasting history if you chose to scroll back in time in the calendar, and additionally you could see your fasting hours, as well as your weight logs in a graph view for the current week, month, and year to see the trends of how you were doing. Well now even those feature are paywalled. Which guess what? Makes the app pretty close to useless unless you’re paying for a subscription. And you know what else? If I was a new user testing out the app, I would immediately delete it, because there’s not even enough bare minimum func

reviews.title: Very poor change to app
reviews.text:
I’ve used Zero for at least 12 months and it has helped my lose over 14lbs. I really liked the simple tracking pillars before the latest update and the screen layouts. 

However everything has now moved, the primary tracking is fasting, protein & hydration.  Unable to customise screens and pillars. Challenges are now more complicated to view and track.  Very poor update and under serious consideration for cancellation unless improved very quickly.  I’ve previously recommended Zero to colleagues but in its current state I cannot.

reviews.title: Latest update ruined the app
reviews.text: A perfect example of a good app that did one thing really well then the developers try and add functionality that other apps do better. Result one failed app. Shame. Been using for a couple of years and will now delete. If it’s not broke done fix it!

reviews.title: Changed pillars
reviews.text: Very annoyed that they’ve changed the four pillars. They swapped out sleep and mindfulness to protein and water. And even worse that I already track both of those in separate apps and yet Zero isn’t pulling it through from my Apple health. Half-hearted update.

reviews.title: App is a scam
reviews.text: The fasting counter doesn’t work without internet connectivity. It was better when it was free, now it’s terrible. Very bad use of money.

reviews.title: Paid Only
reviews.text: The app is paid only to start recording a fast, which it doesn’t tell you on the app or listing page.

reviews.title: Hostile subscription
reviews.text: I’m pretty sure Apple requires free provided features regardless, nonetheless, you can’t actually use without paying for a subscription or “free trial” for 7 days. You’ll the be charged or asked to subscribe, useless. If you want engagement and longevity, give your free users the chance, otherwise I’d rather watch ads on another app.

reviews.title: No free version
reviews.text: You have to sign up to do a free trial and cannot continue without doing this. After the trial ends you are charged over £60. Had to delete immediately what a waste of time

reviews.title: Not working after update
reviews.text:
Updated to new version and now it Doesn’t go past the weight input screen. Keep inputting the weight and hitting save but nothing happens 
Used to work great before this update

reviews.title: Dumb app that requires payment or shows popups
reviews.text: don’t make it free if u have 0 free features

reviews.title: I don’t want to pay for it
reviews.text: I am aware paying gets me extra features, but there needs to be a limit on how many times this app is going to show me the banner asking me to subscribe. Every single time I open the app there is a massive ad asking me to pay, I have to close it and then do my thing. Apple should look into apps like this and get them off the App Store. Paid subs are fine but there should be a limit to how many time I see them.

reviews.title: Subscription prompt every time
reviews.text:
Subscription prompt every time I open the app. Annoying. 
Otherwise, it’s a time counter.

reviews.title: Not a free App!
reviews.text: Downloaded today 01/12/2025 demands a subscription. No free access to any functions!

reviews.title: Forces you to pay
reviews.text: From the moment I opened the app the pop up to start a trial opens and you cannot minimise it or close it and there’s no option for “no”, I could not even go to settings to delete my account as the pop up comes immediately when you open the app. It also asks you immediately what is your name AND surname which is an unreasonable amount of personal information for an app that just counts hours of fasting. Scam.

reviews.title: Broken in Update
reviews.text: Last update broke the custom timers.  The app just closes.  Needs fixing as this is important to me.

reviews.title: Subscription
reviews.text: Should advertise that you are pushed to subscribe. I downloaded the app in seconds, and as I realised after creating my account that it’s pushing you to subscribe, took me longer time to delete my data and uninstall the app.

reviews.title: Was Good
reviews.text: Since the last update, you can no longer select a custom fast timer. The app just closes. Real shame reached out for support several days ago and no reply. Shame as the free app was quite good!
